Overview

One Person Company Registration in Delhi

Delhi's independent consultants, designers, lawyers-turned-entrepreneurs, boutique traders and solo technology founders use the One Person Company to operate as a company without a co-founder. It gives limited liability, a separate legal identity and the credibility a Delhi corporate or government client expects — while the owner keeps 100% of the shares and all decisions.

Incorporation is online with the MCA. For a Delhi OPC we take care of Delhi stamp duty (linked to authorised capital), the nominee's consent in INC-3, a matching address proof for your Delhi flat or office, and the post-incorporation steps such as bank account, INC-20A and Delhi GST registration.

Delhi specifics

What is specific to Delhi

  • ROC Delhi is your Registrar for annual filings (AOC-4 and MGT-7A) and any changes.
  • Delhi stamp duty is capital-linked — keep authorised capital sensible at the start; it can be increased later.
  • Any Delhi residence or office can be the registered office with the owner's NOC and a recent BSES or Tata Power-DDL bill.
  • The nominee signs INC-3 and provides KYC; they can be anywhere in India.
  • Delhi GST and, if you employ staff, Delhi Shops & Establishment registration follow incorporation.

For the full legal detail — eligibility, benefits, comparison tables and law — see the main One Person Company Registration guide. This page covers what changes when your registered office is in Delhi.

Checklist

Documents required in Delhi

For the member & the nominee

  • PAN card and Aadhaar card
  • Passport, Voter ID or Driving Licence
  • Latest bank statement or utility bill (not older than 2 months)
  • Passport-size photograph
  • Email ID and mobile number

Delhi registered office

  • Latest electricity bill (BSES Rajdhani, BSES Yamuna or Tata Power-DDL), gas, telephone or mobile bill — not older than 2 months
  • NOC from the property owner
  • Rent agreement, if rented or in a co-working space
  • Sale deed, DDA allotment letter or MCD property tax receipt, if self-owned
Step by step

One Person Company Registration process in Delhi

Digital Signature Certificate Day 1–2

Class-3 DSC for the member-director via Aadhaar eKYC.

Name reservation — SPICe+ Part A Day 2–4

Name and trademark check; the name must end with "(OPC) Private Limited".

MoA, AoA & nominee consent Day 3–5

e-MoA, e-AoA, nominee consent in INC-3 and director declarations drafted.

Filing SPICe+ Part B Day 5–7

Incorporation filed with DIN and AGILE-PRO-S; MCA fees and Delhi stamp duty paid online.

Certificate of Incorporation Day 7–10

COI with CIN, PAN and TAN by email.

Bank account & commencement After COI

Current account at a Delhi branch and INC-20A within 180 days.

FAQs

One Person Company Registration in Delhi — common questions

How much does OPC registration cost in Delhi?

Professional fee from ₹999, plus one Digital Signature, MCA fees and Delhi stamp duty based on authorised capital. Itemised written quote before you pay.

Can an NRI register an OPC in Delhi?

Yes. Since 2021 an Indian citizen who is not resident in India can incorporate an OPC. Documents executed abroad need notarisation and apostille.

Can I run a consultancy from my South Delhi flat as an OPC?

Yes. A residential address can be the registered office. For a consultancy with no walk-in customers, this is the most common set-up.

Is an OPC taxed differently from a proprietorship?

Yes. An OPC is a company and pays corporate income tax on its profits; the owner is taxed separately on salary or dividends. Whether this is better than proprietorship slab rates depends on your income — we can run the comparison.

How long does it take?

Typically 7–10 working days from complete documents.
